1.text: Ku munsi wa gatatu hacyujijwe ubukwe i Kana y'i Galilaya, kandi na nyina wa Yesu yari ahari.

2.text: Yesu bamutorana n'abigishwa be ngo batahe ubwo bukwe.

3.text: Nuko vino ishize, nyina wa Yesu aramubwira ati “Nta vino bafite.”

4.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Mubyeyi, tubigendanyemo dute? Igihe cyanjye ntikiragera.”

5.text: Nyina abwira abahereza ati “Icyo ababwira cyose mugikore.”

6.text: Hariho intango esheshatu zaremwe mu mabuye, zashyiriweho kwiyeza nk'uko umugenzo w'Abayuda wari uri, intango yose irimo incuro ebyiri cyangwa eshatu z'amazi.

7.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Mwuzuze intango amazi.” Barazuzuza bageza ku ngara.

8.text: Arababwira ati “Nimudahe noneho mushyire umusangwa mukuru.” Barayamushyīra.

9.text: Uwo musangwa mukuru asogongeye amazi ahindutse vino ntiyamenya aho iturutse, keretse ba bahereza badashye amazi ni bo bari babizi. Umusangwa mukuru ahamagara umukwe

10.text: aramubwira ati “Abandi bose babanza vino nziza, abantu bamara guhaga bakabona kuzana izitaryoshye, ariko wowe ho washyinguye inziza aba ari zo uherutsa.”

11.text: Icyo ni cyo kimenyetso cya mbere Yesu yakoreye i Kana y'i Galilaya, yerekana icyubahiro cye, abigishwa be baramwizera.

12.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo aramanuka ajya i Kaperinawumu, ari kumwe na nyina na bene se n'abigishwa be, ariko ntibamarayo iminsi myinshi.

13.text: Pasika y'Abayuda yenda gusohora, Yesu ajya i Yerusalemu.

14.text: Ageze mu rusengero asangamo abahatundira inka n'intama n'inuma, n'abandi bicaye bavunja ifeza.

15.text: Abohekanya imigozi ayigira nk'ikiboko, bose abirukana n'intama n'inka mu rusengero, amena ifeza z'abaguraga inuma

16.text: ati “Nimukureho bino, mureke guhindura inzu ya Data iguriro.”

17.text: Abigishwa be bibuka uko byanditswe ngo “Ishyaka ry'inzu yawe rirandya.”

18.text: Abayuda baramubaza bati “Ubwo ugize utyo watwereka kimenyetso ki?”

19.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Nimusenye uru rusengero, nanjye nzarwubaka mu minsi itatu.”

20.text: Nuko Abayuda bati “Uru rusengero ko rwubatswe mu myaka mirongo ine n'itandatu, nawe ngo uzarwubaka mu minsi itatu?”

21.text: Ariko urusengero yavugaga ni umubiri we.

22.text: Nuko azuwe abigishwa be bibuka ko yabivuze, bemera ibyanditswe na rya jambo Yesu yari yaravuze.

23.text: Nuko ubwo yari i Yerusalemu mu minsi mikuru ya Pasika, abantu benshi babonye ibimenyetso akora bizera izina rye,

24.text: ariko Yesu ntiyabiringira kuko yari azi abantu bose.

25.text: Ntiyagombaga kubwirwa iby'abantu, kuko ubwe yari azi ibibarimo.
